searchText: <@504202741933932544> could you please merge https://github.com/ConsenSys/teku/pull/6743 in to the `consensys/teku` `4844-interop` branch? cc <@680234424037670912> if you're around 🙏 more likely around than snoozy eu ppl at this part of the day, looking at that now. oh that branch was unprotected, so my automerge went straight through shoudl be better now <@84562395988508672> Sweeeet, tyvm!! `ethpandaops/teku:4844-interop-e74d915` is now running on all the teku nodes, i'll resync them now if any client teams would like to run a new version on `eip4844-devnet-4` feel free to ping me Running versions are being tracked here: https://notes.ethereum.org/38XNCSRmR7CCElI6w7zqzQ?view Thanks! <henridf> I'm trying to sync with devnet 4 but getting ResourceUnavailable for my `BeaconBlockAndBlobsSidecarByR`ange messages from multiple peers. Shouldn't those blobs be available given that `MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOBS_SIDECARS_REQUESTS` is ~ 17 days? <realbigsean> you would also get that response if the request was for a pre 4844 fork block <realbigsean> ah actually also pre finalization you can get that <henridf> True <henridf> but this is epoch 5 <realbigsean> yes if it's finalized we aren't required to serve the blobs by root, only by range <henridf> Oops, sorry, I meant byRange (corrected initial message) <realbigsean> Oh yea by range you shouldn't get that reponse there then, any idea which client is sending it? <henridf> Hmm, I have the peer ID, is there a place/way to get the client from that? <realbigsean> in lighthouse we log our client info with peer ID somewhere so grepping the logs usually works. Checking your /eth/v1/node/peers endpoint would help too cause you can see the libp2p multiaddr and enr <henridf> it looks like there's a mix of nodes. three are definitely teku, but two others are not (can't tell which client they are though) We still have something to fix there, due to empty blobs handling.. checking right now.. fyi: I'm restarting all nodes (with some minutes in between restarts) to apply some new bootnodes I've created this endpoint that spits out some infos for all clients that we're running, including the peer_id: https://bootnode-1.server.4844-devnet-4.ethpandaops.io/meta/api/v1/inventory.json <henridf> Ah nice! Yep so all nodes returning ResourceUnavailable are Teku. Next I need to look into why I'm not peering with other clients...

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <henridf> I'm trying to sync with devnet 4 but getting ResourceUnavailable for my `BeaconBlockAndBlobsSidecarByR`ange messages from multiple peers. Shouldn't those blobs be available given that `MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOBS_SIDECARS_REQUESTS` is ~ 17 days?

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <realbigsean> you would also get that response if the request was for a pre 4844 fork block

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <realbigsean> ah actually also pre finalization you can get that

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <henridf> True

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <henridf> but this is epoch 5

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <realbigsean> yes if it's finalized we aren't required to serve the blobs by root, only by range

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <henridf> Oops, sorry, I meant byRange (corrected initial message)

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <realbigsean> Oh yea by range you shouldn't get that reponse there then, any idea which client is sending it?

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <henridf> Hmm, I have the peer ID, is there a place/way to get the client from that?

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <realbigsean> in lighthouse we log our client info with peer ID somewhere so grepping the logs usually works. Checking your /eth/v1/node/peers endpoint would help too cause you can see the libp2p multiaddr and enr
